heading: Rack Mount PC Mikrotik
bottomHtml:
OTECH BD offers a complete range of Rack Mount PC and MikroTik Router solutions designed for data centers, ISPs, enterprises, and network infrastructure projects in Bangladesh. This category includes MikroTik rack-mount routers, Cloud Core Routers (CCR), CRS switches, rack mount kits, and custom rack mount PC casings suitable for running MikroTik RouterOS on x86 platforms.


Our Rack Mount PC MikroTik solutions are ideal for firewall servers, VPN gateways, bandwidth management, load balancing, and high-performance routing. With standard 19-inch 1U, 2U, and 4U rackmount chassis, these products ensure professional installation, efficient cooling, and easy maintenance in server racks.


OTECH BD supplies reliable and scalable rack mount networking hardware for small offices, enterprise networks, and ISP environments, ensuring stability, performance, and long-term support.
